items.title: Unfocused panes let the background through
items.text: Panes you're not working in are now the more see-through ones, so the window's gradient shows through them and the focused pane stands out. Before, unfocused panes got a background-colored wash that made them the more solid ones.

items.title: Hero mode is glass too
items.text: A pane in hero mode now gets the same glass card as a focused pane.

items.title: Strips stay put when panes come and go
items.text: Closing a pane, or splitting a new one into a collapsed row, no longer brings every minimized strip back out. The panes on show share the space, and the strips stay strips. This applies to rows and columns.

items.title: No solid cards behind strips
items.text: Minimized panes are drawn as their strip alone, so the run on show reads cleanly over the glass.

items.title: Smoother slides
items.text: Each terminal is resized once, after a slide finishes, instead of several times during it.

items.title: Cmd-L for the address bar
items.text: Cmd-L now puts the caret in a viewer's address bar, like a browser. Cmd-D splits again, even in a window that has only viewers.

items.title: Command palette over viewers
items.text: The command palette now opens while a viewer pane is focused, and runs its commands from there.
